content:
The minimum total number of coins needed for \(c\) 3-kopeyka coins is
\[
c+3(c-1)=4c-3.
\]
So
\[
2001 \ge 4c-3 \implies 2004 \ge 4c \implies c \le 501.
\]
This is attainable by arranging
\[
3,\ 1,2,1,\ 3,\ 1,2,1,\ \ldots,\ 3
\]
with 501 threes and 500 blocks of \(1,2,1\).

Thus the maximum possible number of 3-kopeyka coins is
\[
\boxed{501}
\]
